title.zh: 【以太坊基金会推出抗量子签名方案开放挑战 sig.golf】
title.en: 【以太坊基金会推出抗量子签名方案开放挑战 sig.golf】

current_state.zh: The Ethereum Foundation, with EigenLabs and Yukon Research, launched sig.golf, an open automated challenge inviting participants—including AI agents—to design quantum-resistant stateless hash-based signature schemes and prove their security in Lean, ranked by the product of signature size and verification cycles.
